tokens.name: Access Token
tokens.purpose: Stateless user authentication for protected API requests
tokens.storage: Authorization Bearer header / Memory / bk_access cookie
tokens.revocation: Expires naturally; database status checked for sensitive actions
tokens.logoutBehavior: Discarded by client; server refresh token revoked

tokens.name: Refresh Token
tokens.validation: Database lookup against unrevoked hash and unexpired date
tokens.revocation: Explicitly marked revoked_at = NOW() upon rotation, logout, or reuse

tokens.name: Admin Token
tokens.revocation: Expires naturally; MFA required upon initial login
tokens.riskLevel: LOW (Restricted to verified admin users + MFA)

tokens.name: Admin MFA Pending Token
tokens.purpose: Transient challenge token for TOTP verification
tokens.storage: Client memory during MFA challenge flow
tokens.revocation: Expires in 5 minutes; cannot access admin routes
tokens.rotation: Exchanged for 8h Admin Token upon successful TOTP check
